corporate.title: A considered presence at a corporate evening
corporate.body: For receptions, gala dinners, company celebrations, client gatherings and networking, the entertainment sits inside the programme with a measured tone. Guests take part, the room stays central and the setup follows the space available.

reception.title: Receptions
reception.body: The tables accompany the welcome and still leave room to talk.

gala.title: Gala dinners
gala.body: A moment of participation that fits a formal evening.

celebration.title: Company celebrations
celebration.body: Anniversaries and internal parties, paced to the programme.

clients.title: Client entertainment
clients.body: An elegant presence for the evening, without turning it into a separate show.

networking.title: Networking
networking.body: A light shared theme, while conversation between people stays central.

team.title: A shared game, not a course
team.body: The tables can bring colleagues together in entertainment they join: people sit, play and change places. It is an informal moment. It is not training and it promises no effect on work.

participation.title: Participation
participation.body: Those who want to play take a seat. Those who prefer to watch stay with the group.

interaction.title: Easy conversation
interaction.body: The game gives a simple reason to talk outside the meeting.

challenge.title: Shared challenges
challenge.body: The hands create a friendly contest, without the format of an imposed tournament.

collaboration.title: Informal collaboration
collaboration.body: The tables mix people. The programme follows the length of the gathering.

weddings.title: A moment for the guests
weddings.body: During the reception, casino-themed entertainment can give guests another passage in the celebration: elegant, open to different groups and matched to the tone of the evening.
weddings.note: Casino Show looks after this entertainment. The wedding planning, the venue and the table service stay with the hosts.

atmosphere.title: Atmosphere
atmosphere.body: The setup follows the elegance of the celebration and does not take over the night.

guests.title: Guests

birthday.title: Birthdays

anniversary.title: Anniversaries

blackjack.title: Blackjack

roulette.title: The spin that gathers the room
roulette.body: A roulette table gives guests a place to gather, follow the motion and join the entertainment. The setup stays that of an event. It is not a station for play with money, and we do not name table models or quantities.

atmosphere.title: Atmosphere
atmosphere.body: The table becomes a meeting point without taking the whole evening alone.

participation.title: Participation
participation.body: Guests follow the spin and can step into the entertainment.

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.body: The presence in the room follows the space and the programme, in the proposal.

blackjack.title: Short hands, close conversation
blackjack.body: At an event, blackjack is a table where people sit for a few hands and stay in company. It is not a lesson, and we do not promise a fixed number of people at the table. The presence is confirmed in the proposal.

interaction.title: Interaction
interaction.body: Short hands keep the talk going among the people seated.

atmosphere.title: Pace
atmosphere.body: People join and leave a hand without a long commitment.

guests.title: Guests
guests.body: The game is for being together, not for instruction.

poker.title: A table where people sit together
poker.body: The poker of this evening is a social experience: guests follow the hand, talk and share the table. It is not a cash tournament and it has no official competition structure.

table.title: The table
table.body: A gathered place, in the tone of a carefully hosted event.

participation.title: Participation
participation.body: The exchange stays among the guests, at the pace of the evening.

setting.title: Setting
setting.body: The format follows the event in the proposal, without a competition rulebook.

other.title: Two variations for the evening
other.description: Dice and wheel of fortune can sit beside the main tables. We do not publish detailed rules, prizes or a fixed availability.

dice.title: Dice
dice.body: A more immediate pace, useful for varying the evening. Whether the table is included, and what role it has, is decided in the proposal.

wheel.title: Wheel of Fortune
wheel.body: A more spectacular moment, added when it fits the programme. No cash prizes. The presence is confirmed in the proposal.

extras.title: Experiences beside the tables
extras.body: The selfie mirror and the 360 experience are options apart from the games. They are not included automatically, and we do not describe equipment or quantities.
extras.note: The actual combination is confirmed in the proposal, according to the space and the programme.

selfie.title: Selfie mirror
selfie.body: A photo moment for guests. It is considered only when it suits the evening.

experience.title: 360 experience
experience.body: A short visual moment around the guest. It is optional, and availability is confirmed in the proposal.

idea.title: The appeal of the casino, in another form
idea.body: The tables, the gesture of play and the light of an evening have a particular appeal. Here that appeal becomes live entertainment: people come closer, try, comment and stay with the experience.
idea.aside: The energy comes from being in the room, not from a win. Taking part is the pleasure of the encounter, not a wager for money.

experience.title: People are at the centre

participation.title: Participation

conversation.title: Conversation

discovery.title: Discovery

shared.title: Shared enjoyment

atmosphere.title: Atmosphere
